Timeless over trendy is our motto

Joah Love started back in 2008 with the goal of designing a
line of children’s clothing that was fuss-free, seriously cool and made
locally in sunny California.

Beloved by boys and girls, and crafted from the softest knit
fabrics and always with that amazing soft, vintage feel
that has become a beloved and defining element of everything Joah Love. Not a lot of snaps, zips or extra bits because we don't want to keep our kids at maximum comfort. That’s the way we like it. You will too. So will your children.
